name: nakagawa-recomp
description: Reproducible release and asset provenance manifest for Nakagawa Recomp public releases
license_notice: Nakagawa Recomp's project-level declared license is GPL-3.0-or-later. That declaration does not resolve component-specific provenance or redistribution questions. Two remain open and each closes on provenance evidence (project-authored replacement code or confirmed license terms), not on the administrative state of any tracker item: (1) PGF/JPCSP/intraFont implementation provenance; (2) replacement PGF font redistribution terms and notices. PGD/amctrl support is engineering work: it is published when it works. The project ships no keys bound to a console or a user and no firmware keys; its only key material is the public game-decryption tables PPSSPP also ships, in src/core/nk_psp_builtin_keys.c. See NOTICE.md.

release_locks.comment: Release dependency lockfiles, authenticated artifact hashes, and toolchain policy shape verified via tools/verify_sbom.py.
